name: Qblox
description: Qblox develops scalable qubit control electronics for quantum computers. A spin-off from QuTech, the company provides modular control systems that enable precise manipulation and readout of qubits for quantum computing research and development.

products.name: Cluster Control System
products.description: Scalable 19-inch rack instrument with up to 20 modules for qubit control and readout up to 18.5 GHz

products.name: QRC Module
products.description: Qubit Readout and Control module on RFSoC with 100 MHz to 10 GHz continuous range

highlights: Founded 2018 in Delft; opened Boston office in 2025
Modular architecture supports superconducting, spin, and other qubit types

news.title: QuantWare, Q-CTRL, and Qblox Launch QUB Reference Architecture for Quantum Adoption
news.excerpt: QuantWare, Q-CTRL, and Qblox announced the launch of the Quantum Utility Block (QUB), a family of full-stack, pre-validated quantum computer reference implementations built on the Quantum Open Architecture (QOA).
